name: Minase Aoi
source:
"You can't run away from me anymore... You're going to stay by my side like this the whole day."

The cool blizzard of Mercury.
The Mercury Prince

The prince of Mercury who only speaks when necessary, and doesn’t really show any emotions.
He's honest and always speaks frankly, though at first glance it may make him seem rude he's always thinking kindly of his partners feelings.
